# These symbols must be disabled or absent from the Android product's kernel:
# the desktop-only choices (XFS, Btrfs and the SMB client among them), the
# ACK-only features the product does without, and what Android's CTS and
# security requirements forbid (the NFS client, SysV IPC, auxiliary POSIX
# clocks, and RDS, whose TCP transport is a kernel listener on port 16385).
CONFIG_ANDROID_BINDER_IPC_RUST
CONFIG_ASHMEM
CONFIG_BPF_JIT
CONFIG_BPF_JIT_ALWAYS_ON
CONFIG_BTRFS_FS
CONFIG_CHECKPOINT_RESTORE
CONFIG_CIFS
CONFIG_DM_DEFAULT_KEY
CONFIG_HAVE_EBPF_JIT
CONFIG_HOSTFS
CONFIG_IP_PNP
CONFIG_IP_PNP_DHCP
CONFIG_IP_SCTP
CONFIG_MODULES
CONFIG_NFS_FS
CONFIG_POSIX_AUX_CLOCKS
CONFIG_RDS
CONFIG_RDS_TCP
CONFIG_SECURITY_SMACK
CONFIG_SYSVIPC
CONFIG_UCLAMP_TASK
CONFIG_UCLAMP_TASK_GROUP
CONFIG_UID_SYS_STATS
CONFIG_WERROR
CONFIG_XFS_FS
